title_en: Kerala PSC LDC / Lower Division Clerk
description_ml: പത്താം തരം യോഗ്യതയുള്ള പ്രധാന കേരള പി.എസ്.സി പരീക്ഷ.
description_en: Flagship 10th-level competitive examination conducted across all 14 districts in Kerala.
syllabus_overview: General Knowledge (50 marks), Simple Arithmetic & Mental Ability (20 marks), General English (20 marks), Malayalam (10 marks). Total: 100 marks.
eligibility: SSLC / 10th Standard Pass. Age 18-36 (OBC/SC/ST relaxations apply).
important_dates: Exam Cycle: Biennial / Notification published periodically.

description_ml: സെക്രട്ടേറിയറ്റ് അസിസ്റ്റന്റ്, യൂണിവേഴ്സിറ്റി അസിസ്റ്റന്റ് തുടങ്ങിയ പദവികളിലേക്കുള്ള പൊതു പരീക്ഷ.
description_en: Common preliminary screening test for Secretariat, University, and Sub-Inspector posts.
syllabus_overview: History, Geography, Economics, Civics, Science, Quantitative Aptitude, English, Malayalam, IT & Cyber Laws.
eligibility: Graduation in any discipline from a recognized university.
mark_distribution: 100 Marks, 75 Minutes duration, Objective OMR format.

description_en: Popular state-level exam requiring 7th standard qualification.
syllabus_overview: General Knowledge, Current Affairs, Renaissance in Kerala, Science, Mathematics & Mental Ability.
eligibility: Passed Standard VII and must not have acquired degree.

description_ml: കേരള പൊതുവിദ്യാഭ്യാസ വകുപ്പിലെ പ്രൈമറി സ്കൂൾ അധ്യാപക നിയമന പരീക്ഷ.
description_en: Teacher recruitment examination for Lower & Upper Primary government schools.
syllabus_overview: Child Psychology & Pedagogy, Subject Content (Science, Maths, Social Science), Malayalam, English, General Knowledge.
eligibility: TTC / D.El.Ed / B.Ed with K-TET Category 1 / 2.
